The flavors of the various fruits in this simmered dish exist in perfect harmony.|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== [[Link]] can make Copious Simmered Fruits by [[Cooking]] four different [[Fruit]]s together in a [[Cooking Pot]]. Their default version can be made by using at least two Fruits with differing [[Added Effect]]s. Eating them will heal some of Link's [[Heart]]s to his [[Life Gauge]]. The flavors of the Fruits used in these [[Meal]]s exist in perfect harmony. If Link uses an [[Apple]], a [[Wildberry]], and a [[Palm Fruit]] when making Copious Simmered Fruits, the fourth Fruit that he uses will grant the dish a status effect. This can result in the following variations: * '''Hearty Copious Simmered Fruit''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Copious Simmered Fruit}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
The flavors of the various fruits in this simmered dish exist in perfect harmony.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Hearty Durian]]s. When eaten, they'll heal all of Link's Hearts and grant him temporary Hearts. * '''Hasty Copious Simmered Fruit''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Copious Simmered Fruit}}
>Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
The flavors of the various fruits in this simmered dish exist in perfect harmony.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Fleet-Lotus Seeds]]. Link's movement speed will receive a boost when he eats these. * '''Spicy Copious Simmered Fruit''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Copious Simmered Fruit}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
The flavors of the various fruits in this simmered dish exist in perfect harmony.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Spicy Pepper]]s. These fruits will grant Link one level of [[Cold Resistance]] if he eats them. * '''Electro Copious Simmered Fruit''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Copious Simmered Fruit}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
The flavors of the various fruits in this simmered dish exist in perfect harmony.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Voltfruit]]s. By eating them, Link can gain one level of [[Shock Resistance]]. * '''Mighty Copious Simmered Fruit''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Copious Simmered Fruit}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
The flavors of the various fruits in this simmered dish exist in perfect harmony.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Mighty Bananas]]. If they're eaten, they'll grant Link a boost to the power of his attacks. * '''Chilly Copious Simmered Fruit''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Copious Simmered Fruit}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
The flavors of the various fruits in this simmered dish exist in perfect harmony.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Hydromelon]]s. These meals can be eaten to provide Link one level of [[Heat Resistance]]. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} Copious Simmered Fruits can be made by [[Cooking]] at least four different types of [[Fruit]] together. Their default versions can be made by using a combination of [[Apple]]s, [[Golden Apple]]s, [[Hylian Tomato]]es, [[Palm Fruit]]s, and [[Wildberry|Wildberries]], all of which grant no [[Added Effect]]s. Variations can be made by using Fruits that grant an Added Effect. Alternatively, [[Link]] can use a fifth ingredient to create variations as well. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Meal * Simmered Fruit }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals |items= BotW, TotK }}
